words.name: Make a deal
words.blurb: Truces and trades with a bot, and what breaking one costs.
words.opening: Lady Morwen, a Captain, holds Fairmark right on your border, and neither of you needs a war there yet. Deals are preset cards: you pick one, and a bot answers at once.
words.goal: Agree a truce with Lady Morwen and keep it for two turns, and make a trade with her, by turn 5.
words.met: Your truce with Lady Morwen has held two turns, and you've traded
hints: Tap Lady Morwen in the Houses panel, then Propose a deal. A plain truce is ready to send, and she answers at once.
Now a trade: the Trade card swaps gold or land. Offer Lady Morwen a little gold and see what she says.
Handshake deals are free but can be broken, for the Oathbreaker mark, a fine and unrest. Binding ones cost gold up front.
words.closing: Deals keep one front quiet while you fight on another. Break one, and everyone sees the mark.
